title: Forms without JavaScript: a normal POST, the redirect and the message on the page
description: A visitor of the forms module's form (the FORM of modules/forms/tests/lib.mjs) with JavaScript OFF: the form is a real <form> that posts, the server redirects back to the page with ?af_result=…#af-contacto-status and the message is on the page; the submission is stored. The minimum fill time is 0 here (it is the server's, level 2). Read by browser-forms-no-js. It was the no-JS case of browser.test.mjs (level 3) until 29-10-2026.
